Question 1
?

Which of the following is equivalent to the integral ∫C4xy2ds, where C is the section of the curve x=2y traversed between the points (2,1) and (13,6), as shown above?

Hint: Use the parameter y=t.

a
∫1/32t4+8tdt
b
8∫16t4+4tdt
c
4∫16t4+1tdt
d
8∫1/32t4+4tdt
e
∫16t4+8tdt
